defs.def: an accepted way of behaving or of doing things in a society or a community 风俗；习俗

ex.s: customs of the world are on display
ex.t: 世界各地的风俗在此展示

ex.s: We did not speak the local language, did not know the customs, and more often than not, did not entirely recognize the food.
ex.t: 我们不会说当地语言，不了解当地习俗，而且往往认不出食物。

ex.s: While going on your first trip to the UK is exciting, new and different customs can also be confusing.
ex.t: 虽然第一次去英国旅行令人兴奋，但新奇不同的习俗也可能让人困惑。

ex.s: Depending on regional customs, it may be acceptable to be 15 to 30 minutes late.
ex.t: 根据当地习俗，迟到15到30分钟可能是可以接受的。

ex.s: Daji originated from the ancient folk custom of trading goods, which dates back to
ex.t: 大集起源于古老的民间货物交易习俗，其历史可追溯到

defs.def: the way a person always behaves （个人的）习惯，习性，惯常行为
the fact of a person or people buying goods or services at a shop/store or business （顾客对商店的）惠顾，光顾

ex.s: You ask your customer whether he/she needs a doggie bag.
ex.t: 你询问顾客是否需要打包袋。

ex.s: The customers must have got up very early.
You want to persuade a customer to buy a new mixed fruit drink.
ex.t: 你想说服顾客购买一种新的混合果汁饮料。
